create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" text not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "public"."pick"("n" integer) returns integer language sql volatile security invoker begin atomic select n + 1; end;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "public"."pick"("s" text) returns text language sql volatile security invoker begin atomic select s || '!'; end;
